newsitem.title: USA: Westcoast B.C. gas plant to shut for planned work.
newsitem.headline: Westcoast B.C. gas plant to shut for planned work.

text.p: Westcoast Energy's Fort Nelson natural gas processing plant, in northeastern British Columbia, will be shut in several hours for planned maintenance, the company said Monday.

The plant, with a total capacity of 750 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd), will be shut as scheduled at 1201 PDT Tuesday and is expected to last until June 18, Westcoast Field Services division president Irv Koop said.
As a result of the outage, current flows have been restricted to about 470 mmcfd, which includes both firm and interruptible transportation, he added.
Spot prices at Sumas, Wash., for Tuesday delivery rose more than 10 cents to about $1.30 per million British thermal units, traders said.
